svg.title: Orssiryu Droyne Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 28-29, PDF 29-30. Full single-deck projection preserves long twin forward prongs with open bow gap, narrowing neck, broad pod-cluster body, side drive pods and rounded cargo stern. Illustration corroborates organic rear body and forked nose; curves simplified from plan, interior living/cargo borders excluded.
